title: Gradient estimates for singular elliptic measure data problems with double phase
summary: We consider elliptic measure data problems of the type \[ -\mathrm{div}\,(|Du|^{p-2}Du+a(x)|Du|^{q-2}Du) = μ\] in a bounded domain in $\mathbb{R}^n$, where $p<q$ and $a(\cdot) \ge 0$. We prove local Calderón--Zygmund estimates in the singular case $2-1/n < p < 2$, under natural assumptions on $p$, $q$ and $a(\cdot)$.
